sources.title: ISO 9241-112:2025 Ergonomics of human-system interaction — Part 112: Principles for the presentation of information
sources.license_note: Paywalled ISO standard; only public abstract, lifecycle and status synthesized
mechanisms_absorbed: presentation principles apply across visual auditory and tactile/haptic modalities
presentation principles refine perception and understanding rather than creating a new surface owner

sources.title: ISO 9241-222:2026 Ergonomics of human-system interaction — Part 222: Self-assessment of human-centred design approach
sources.license_note: Paywalled ISO standard; public abstract and status only
mechanisms_absorbed: human-centred design can be self-assessed across organizational principles processes and activities
process assessment belongs to research and design governance rather than a new UI surface faculty

sources.title: ISO/IEC 4944:2024 Information technology — User interfaces — Evaluating usability of natural user interfaces
sources.license_note: Paywalled ISO/IEC standard; public abstract and lifecycle only
mechanisms_absorbed: NUI usability evaluation is framed through effectiveness efficiency and satisfaction
evaluation evidence refines research validity and modality assessment without creating a new interaction owner

sources.title: ISO/IEC 7818:2025 Information technology — User interfaces — Framework of voice user interfaces for personal mobility services
sources.license_note: Paywalled ISO/IEC standard; public abstract and status only
mechanisms_absorbed: voice UI for personal mobility has functional and performance requirements
user-facing decisions compose voice interaction mobility constraints and operation semantics

sources.title: ISO 9241-920:2024 Ergonomics of human-system interaction — Part 920: Tactile and haptic interactions
sources.license_note: Paywalled ISO standard; public abstract and status only
mechanisms_absorbed: tactile and haptic interactions span inputs outputs and multimodal combinations
the decision class is already owned by multisensory plus perceptual-motor and alternative-input faculties

sources.title: ISO/IEC 23090-28:2026 Information technology — Coded representation of immersive media — Part 28: Interchangeable scene-based media representations
sources.license_note: Paywalled ISO/IEC standard; public abstract and lifecycle only
mechanisms_absorbed: scene-based immersive media can carry audio visual tactile and other representations
user-facing interaction decomposes into spatial presentation media alternatives and multisensory faculties

sources.title: ISO/IEC CD 25420 Information technology — User interfaces — Multimodal interaction for customer service systems
sources.status: Committee Draft under development; stage 30.60 shown in 2026 and approved for registration as DIS
sources.license_note: Paywalled draft; public abstract/lifecycle only; never treated as a published conformance requirement
mechanisms_absorbed: multimodal customer-service systems combine multiple interaction channels through an interoperable functional architecture
the UI decisions decompose into modality cross-device and realtime faculties instead of needing a vertical-specific owner
